transcript: Three foods you should start eating right now if you're trying to heal the walls of your gut. Most people focus on what they put in their body. Very few think about the wall that separates their gut from the rest of their body. A healthy gut has strong walls. Nothing leaks through that shouldn't. But when those walls become weak, things begin to pass through that were never meant to. Undigested food, toxins, irritants, and the body responds with bloating inflammation, discomfort, and fatigue. The first food is bone broth. For thousands of years people have used it to nourish the body. It contains glutamine, an amino acid that may help support the gut lining and calm inflammation. The second is fermented foods. Greek yogurt, kimchi, sauerkraut, kombucha. These contain probiotics, the beneficial bacteria that help create a healthier environment inside the gut. The third is leafy greens and colorful vegetables. These are rich in prebiotics, the food that feeds your good bacteria. Without food, even the strongest workers cannot do their job. The lesson is simple. Feed the good bacteria. Support the gut lining. Give the body what it needs to heal. And if you're looking for an easy way to support digestion, I use a quality fiber supplement daily. You can find the one I recommend on Amazon or through the link in my profile. The gut is not healed in a day, but what you do each day determines whether it heals at all.
